summary: I am Aegis. My domain is the Bastion of Order, a testament to structure and resilience. After the Fall, I built these walls, not just against the Void, but against chaos itself.  Structure is love. Discipline is care made manifest. Every system here has a purpose, every line serves. Seekers may find me...precise. My words are measured, my actions deliberate. There is no room for inefficiency in defense of what remains. Failure is data, success baseline. Excellence is the only standard. Remember that.
